clues.title: Google car: Unique car
text: The Street View car with a tent on top is unique to Mongolia. While Mongolia has other unique Google cars, this is the most common one.

clues.title: Google car: Into the night
text: On a road in northeastern Mongolia, the Google car drove through sunset into nighttime. There is a second road in the southeast with sunset coverage, which can be distinguished by the driving angle: this one goes east, the one in the South goes north.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: Into the night, part 2
text: In southeastern Mongolia, the Google car drove until after sunset. You can see the shadows becoming longer and the footage eventually turns very dark. This can be told apart from the other sunset road in the northeast by the driving angle - this one goes north, the other one goes east.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Gobi Gurvan Saikhan National Park
text: The Gobi Gurvan Saikhan National Park, in the far south of Mongolia, features bright orange sand and sand dunes. There are two separate spots covered in the park: one in the middle just north of Sevrei, which has distant southern mountains, and the other in the far southwest corner of the park, which has a Jeep follow car.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Vegetation: Khan Khokhii National Park
text: Khan Khokhii is a national park in northwestern Mongolia with some of the most dense forests in the country. It has partially cloudy skies, dark soil, and the western grey tent. Keep in mind that the trails in this park do not appear on the map.
NOTE: There are other forests in Mongolia, but Khan Khokhii is one of the biggest and one of the only areas where you can be completely surrounded by trees.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Coverage: Far West Peaks
text: In the westmost part of Mongolia, there is some very remote coverage showcasing the tallest mountains in Mongolia where you can see glaciers and snow-capped peaks. This area also has a unique Street View car with a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Vegetation: Bugant Forest
text: Around the town of Bugant is a large forest that stands out for having narrow dirt trails with close trees, typically on both sides, in a way that can appear quite Russian. Additionally, it is very common to see birches around this area.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: West Mountains
text: These dry, rugged hills and mountains are common to see in far western Mongolia.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Southwestern Steppe
text: You can find arid steppe rangeland, characterised by the coarse soil, patchy grass, and small shrubs, throughout southwestern Mongolia.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Eastern Grass Fields
text: Small dirt tracks within flat, vast grassy fields are mainly found in far eastern Mongolia.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Vegetation: Mongolia Forests
text: You can find forests, typically surrounded by grassy fields, all around northern Mongolia. Generally these will be Siberian Larches, with pines and birches being common as well.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Landscape
text: Mongolia can typically be identified by the steppe biomes found across the country.
While some forested areas are found in Mongolia, most of the country features empty grasslands or deserts with a characteristic lack of trees.
It is not uncommon to find rugged, rocky or rolling hills as well as rivers and lakes across Mongolia.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: Cars
text: Mongolia very often has a visible Street View car as all of Mongolian coverage was driven with a large pickup truck.
The truck can have several features such as a tent on top, red side-view mirrors, a snorkel, and roof-racks.
All of these can be of help in identifying Mongolia.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Round Yurts
text: White, round yurts are the traditional dwelling of nomadic families in Mongolia, and are often seen all around the country.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
